description: Build the complete Owner Master Control Panel pages: Dashboard, Users Management, Activity Logs, Content & Branding, System Control, and Educational Overview. Each page follows the existing Stitch design patterns with premium styling, using the Card/MetricCard/Badge/ProgressBar primitives and Lucide icons. Pages use the hooks from useOwner.ts for data fetching with mock/static fallback data for a polished demo experience.
steps: 1. Create frontend/src/pages/owner/OwnerDashboardPage.tsx - The main overview page with: (a) grid-4 of MetricCards showing total users, active users, total courses, total enrollments; (b) a grid-2-1 layout with a Card showing user distribution by role (using ProgressBar for each role count), and a Card showing system health indicators (uptime, DB status, last sync); (c) a Card with recent platform events table (last 10 audit log entries); (d) a Card with quick-action buttons (trigger sync, toggle maintenance, export report). Use Chart.js doughnut chart for user distribution. Include Arabic labels throughout. Fetch data via useOwnerStats hook with static fallback data for demo.

2. Create frontend/src/pages/owner/OwnerUsersPage.tsx - Full user management page: (a) grid-4 MetricCards for total users, students, teachers, admins; (b) search input + role filter pills (all, STUDENT, TEACHER, ADMIN, QUALITY, OWNER); (c) professional data table with columns: avatar+name, email, role (as Badge), status (active/inactive Badge), joined date, actions dropdown; (d) Each row has actions: view profile, change role (with confirmation modal), toggle active status (with confirmation). Use useOwnerUsers hook with pagination. Include a ConfirmDialog component for destructive actions.

3. Create frontend/src/pages/owner/OwnerActivityPage.tsx - Activity monitoring and audit trail: (a) MetricCards for total events today, logins today, failed actions, role changes; (b) filter tabs for event type (all, auth, content, roles, system); (c) timeline-style event list showing: icon, action description, user who performed it, timestamp, metadata preview. Each event type has a distinct icon/color. Use useOwnerActivity hook with pagination and type filter. Include date range filter UI.

4. Create frontend/src/pages/owner/OwnerContentPage.tsx - Content and branding control: (a) Card for Hero Content editing - textarea inputs for hero title, subtitle, CTA text with a live preview panel; (b) Card for Theme Settings - color pickers for primary, secondary, accent colors (just input type=color); (c) Card for Platform Announcements - form to create new announcement with scope selector (platform/faculty); (d) Card for Feature Toggles - list of toggleable modules (AI Assistant, Virtual Labs, Community, Live Streaming, etc.) each with a toggle switch; (e) Card for Logo/Branding upload placeholder. All use local state with save buttons that show success feedback.

5. Create frontend/src/pages/owner/OwnerSystemPage.tsx - System control page: (a) MetricCards for server status, last sync time, pending migrations, error count; (b) Card for Sync Management with sync history table and manual trigger button (reuse pattern from AdminSyncPage.tsx); (c) Card for Feature Flags with toggle switches and descriptions; (d) Card for Maintenance Mode toggle with warning/confirmation; (e) Card for Error Log showing recent errors with timestamps and stack trace expandable; (f) Card for Platform Settings with key-value editor for system config.

6. Create frontend/src/pages/owner/OwnerEducationPage.tsx - Educational overview: (a) MetricCards for total courses, total professors, active offerings, average enrollment; (b) Card with courses-per-faculty bar chart using Chart.js; (c) Card with top courses by enrollment table; (d) Card with professor workload overview (courses per teacher distribution); (e) Card with attendance and engagement trends using a line chart; (f) Card with exam status breakdown (draft, published, completed).

7. Create frontend/src/components/owner/ConfirmDialog.tsx - A reusable confirmation dialog component for destructive actions. Uses glassmorphism overlay, has title, message, confirm/cancel buttons with appropriate colors (danger red for destructive actions). Includes an onConfirm async callback.

8. Create frontend/src/components/owner/ToggleSwitch.tsx - A premium toggle switch component styled with Stitch tokens. Has label, description, checked state, onChange handler. Used in feature toggles and system controls.

9. Add owner-specific CSS to frontend/src/styles/owner.css with premium styling: owner-specific card enhancements, timeline styles for activity page, toggle switch styles, confirm dialog overlay styles, enhanced table styles for user management. Import this CSS in frontend/src/main.tsx.
10. Update the stub pages in frontend/src/pages/owner/OwnerPages.tsx to properly export all the real page components from their individual files (re-export barrel).
11. Update App.tsx imports to use the real page components from the owner directory instead of stubs.
acceptance_criteria: Owner dashboard page renders with MetricCards, charts, and recent events
Users page has search, filter, paginated table with role/status management actions
Activity page shows audit trail with type filtering and timeline UI
Content page has editable branding controls, feature toggles, and announcement form
System page has sync management, feature flags, maintenance mode, and error logs
Education page has charts and tables for courses, professors, and engagement
ConfirmDialog component works for destructive action confirmation
ToggleSwitch component provides on/off control for feature flags
All pages follow RTL Arabic layout with Stitch design tokens
All pages use Lucide icons consistently
verification: Run: cd /projects/sandbox/madarek/frontend && npx tsc -b --noEmit (should pass with no errors)
findings: TypeScript type-checking cannot run because node_modules are not installed (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode). This is consistent with FEAT-001 findings. All code follows existing patterns exactly: uses same primitives (Card, MetricCard, Badge, ProgressBar, Pill, Tabs, UserAvatar), same Icon component, same Chart.js registration pattern from QualityPages.tsx, same page structure with page/page-header/page-title-block classes. All 6 pages created with full Arabic content, RTL layout, and static fallback data.
